snippet.title: Force Restart - First Look Teaser for Psychological Survival Horror Game
snippet.description:
A darkness creeps into a man's life, twisting his reality. In FORCE RESTART, a first-person psychological survival horror thriller, explore mind-bending worlds and experience haunting storytelling as you struggle to escape the VOID.

Be a part of the journey:
✨Wishlist on Steam!
💪Back us on Kickstarter!
